latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — a skill to rewrite abstract, jargon-heavy passages into concrete, sensory language the audience can picture, using three specific techniques.

- Flags abstract or strategy-level language in drafts (e.g., value props, mission statements, product pages).
- Rewrites flagged passages side-by-side using one of: schema tap, high-concept pitch, or generative analogy.
- Requires two key inputs: the abstract passage(s) and audience reference points; defaults to “intelligent non-expert” if audience is unspecified.
- Avoids inventing new sensory details—only grounds claims actually present in the draft.
- For use by marketers, founders, communicators, and anyone needing clearer, more tangible messaging.
